create_train_options: create a TrainOptions instance and initialize it to configure training arguments for audio-visual separation
parse_train_arguments: parse command-line training arguments for audio-visual separation model with validation, loss weights, and optimizer settings
configure_model_losses: configure model arguments including coseparation loss, reconstruction loss, crossmodal loss, and triplet loss types
setup_visual_audio_features: setup visual and audio feature arguments including pooling type, feature dimensions, and compression methods
configure_training_optimizer: configure training optimizer arguments including learning rates per stream, optimizer type, and weight decay
